instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ahmed Shakir Abd Al-Rida
subject: 03_Data_Mining

questions.question: How does a retailer use point-of-sale records?
questions.question_ar: كيف يستفيد بائع التجزئة من سجلات نقاط البيع؟
options: to hire many new cashiers now
options_en: to hire many new cashiers now
questions.explanation: The records show what customers buy, so the retailer can plan products and promotions.
questions.explanation_ar: السجلات تُظهر ما يشتريه العملاء، فيخطط التاجر للمنتجات والعروض.

questions.question: What can data mining forecast in healthcare?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي يمكن أن يتنبأ به تنقيب البيانات في الرعاية الصحية؟
questions.explanation: It forecasts patient outcomes and helps reduce the cost of care.
questions.explanation_ar: يتنبأ بنتائج المرضى ويساعد على خفض كلفة الرعاية.

questions.question: What does market basket analysis assume?
options: prices fall during the whole day
shops open at fixed morning hours
a purchase always ends the visit
options_en: prices fall during the whole day
shops open at fixed morning hours
a purchase always ends the visit
questions.explanation: The hypothesis is that buying one group of products makes buying another group more likely.
questions.explanation_ar: الفرضية أن شراء مجموعة منتجات يزيد احتمال شراء مجموعة أخرى.

questions.question: What does educational data mining study?
questions.explanation: It studies learners' future behaviour and the effect of educational support.
questions.explanation_ar: يدرس سلوك المتعلمين مستقبلاً وأثر الدعم التعليمي.

questions.question: Which relationships can data mining reveal in manufacturing?
questions.question_ar: أي علاقات يكشفها تنقيب البيانات في التصنيع؟
questions.explanation: It links product architecture, the product portfolio and the data needs of customers.
questions.explanation_ar: يربط معمارية المنتج ومحفظة المنتجات وحاجات العملاء من البيانات.

questions.question: What is the goal of customer relationship management?
options: raising the prices every single year
options_en: raising the prices every single year
questions.explanation: CRM aims to obtain and keep customers and to strengthen their loyalty.
questions.explanation_ar: إدارة العلاقات تهدف لكسب العملاء والاحتفاظ بهم وتقوية ولائهم.

questions.question: How does a supervised fraud system work?
questions.question_ar: كيف يعمل نظام كشف الاحتيال المشرف؟
options: it ignores all past transactions here
it asks customers to call first now
it learns from labelled sample records
it blocks every card at once here
options_en: it ignores all past transactions here
it asks customers to call first now
it learns from labelled sample records
it blocks every card at once here
questions.explanation: It is trained on sample records already marked as fraudulent or normal, then classifies new ones.
questions.explanation_ar: يُدرَّب على سجلات موسومة مسبقاً كاحتيال أو طبيعية، ثم يصنّف الجديدة.
